hero.lede: From Basel to Lugano, our local communities bring coaches together to learn, reflect and grow — in person and online.

intro: Local communities are the heart of the chapter. Each one is run by volunteer coaches who host regular gatherings — peer coaching, supervision circles, guest speakers and informal exchange. Everyone is welcome, whether you are credentialed, training, or simply curious about the profession.
